changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.14
changeSet.comment: nexus.catalog_collection_owner_replaceable(tenant, owner_id) no longer treats a curator owner as replaceable: only an owner_id that is not tumbler-shaped is (RDR-229, owner is the source). Same signature, grants and SECURITY INVOKER; no data effect.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.catalog_collection_owner_replaceable(p_tenant text, p_owner text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT COALESCE(p_owner !~ '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)*$', true) $fn$;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.catalog_collection_owner_replaceable(p_tenant text, p_owner text) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT COALESCE(p_owner !~ '^[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)*$', true) OR nexus.catalog_owner_is_curator(p_tenant, p_owner) $fn$;

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.14
changeSet.comment: nexus.collection_tuple_lock_key(tenant, content_type, owner_id, embedding_model, model_version) returns the 64-bit advisory-lock key of a collection tuple: md5 of a length-prefixed encoding of the five parts, first 64 bits as a signed bigint. The one derivation every tuple-lock taker uses (the 049-2 triggers and the Java CollectionTupleLock). IMMUTABLE, PARALLEL SAFE, SECURITY INVOKER; no data effect.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.collection_tuple_lock_key(p_tenant text, p_content_type text, p_owner_id text, p_embedding_model text, p_model_version text) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE SECURITY INVOKER AS $fn$ SELECT ('x' || left(md5( '13:catalog_tuple' || length(coalesce(p_tenant, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_tenant, '') || length(coalesce(p_content_type, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_content_type, '') || length(coalesce(p_owner_id, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_owner_id, '') || length(coalesce(p_embedding_model, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_embedding_model, '') || length(coalesce(p_model_version, ''))::text || ':' || coalesce(p_model_version, '') ), 16))::bit(64)::bigint $fn$;

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.collection_tuple_lock_key(text, text, text, text, text);

changeSet.author: nexus-p2m1x.14
changeSet.comment: catalog-044's two owner-from-documents trigger functions skip the rewrite when the new owner would land an unsuperseded, non-quarantine code/docs/rdr collection on a (tenant_id, content_type, owner_id, embedding_model, model_version) tuple another unsuperseded, non-quarantine collection already holds: the old owner stays and a NOTICE names both collections and the owner not taken. Same signatures and SECURITY INVOKER; each takes the tuple's advisory lock through nexus.collection_tuple_lock_key before its holder lookup; no data effect.
